mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic properties and minocycline can inhibit CYP3A4, which metabolizes tolterodine, potentially increasing tolterodine levels and anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic symptoms (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, tachycardia); consider dose adjustment of tolterodine or use alternative antibiotic if anticholinergic effects worsen.
